name: BOB: Baseline Object Broker
shortDescription: Measure real objects from a photo in the browser: OpenCV.js finds a $1 coin for scale, then gives every edge and perimeter in millimetres.
description:
BOB is a client-side measurement tool. A Canadian $1 coin (26.5 mm) in the photo sets the pixels-per-millimetre scale, and every other object's edges and perimeter follow from it. All the vision runs in the browser with OpenCV.js.

Highlights:
- Contour detection with edge detection and polygon approximation, drawn as overlays that follow each object's real shape and scale with the view.
- Automatic coin detection by circularity and size, or manual calibration by clicking two points.
- Select, name and colour objects, or click out a custom polygon to measure something the detector missed.
